terra.problem: The text does not say the magicians held up their serpents proudly or that Aaron’s serpent went down a line. It says they threw down their staffs and Aaron’s staff swallowed the others.
The text says the Egyptians dug around the Nile, but it does not say they used shovels.
The explanation says the verse has shovels, but it does not mention what the Egyptians used to dig.
